text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just you, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just you, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I read a scary book before<n>going to bed
last night.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then, I kept thinking about which<n>direction the
plushies on my desk<n>were facing, and how loudly
the clock<n>was ticking...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then everything started to bother<n>me... I couldn't
sleep at all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Rice Shower is<n>sleep-deprived. Hopefully
she's able<n>to get a proper rest soon.
